title: The hub tags an unstarted task "Not yet started" and a finished one "Completed", where Design release 1 says "To do" and "Complete"

finding.frontend: The status beside an unstarted but startable task reads "Not yet started" in a blue tag, and beside a finished one it reads "Completed" in a green tag. The hub carries three further status words the design does not use: "Cannot start yet" for a locked row, "In progress" and "Optional". All five are set at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/copy/copy.en.js:11-17 and mapped to tags at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/controller.js:51-68.
finding.prototype: Design release 1 uses two status words and no others: "To do" in a blue tag and "Complete" in a green tag (app/routes.js:5736-5737). Every row on a fresh notification reads "To do"; a finished row reads "Complete". The colours match the frontend's; only the words differ.
finding.difference: Change the hub's status words to "To do" and "Complete" at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/copy/copy.en.js:11-17, keeping the blue and green tags as they are. "Cannot start yet" disappears with the row locking (hub--task-rows-locked-until-earlier-work-is-done). "In progress" and "Optional" have no counterpart in Design release 1 at all, so decide against the design where they should be shown; neither appears on either captured hub state, so this finding does not claim what a user meets when they fire.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding "To do" or "Complete" as the status text on any row of either captured frontend hub state. fe-hub renders "Not yet started" once and "Cannot start yet" ten times; fe-hub-part-answered renders "Completed" once.
finding.verification: Read all four rendered DOMs and all four screenshots. Ran the falsifier: neither "To do" nor "Complete" appears in fe-hub.html or fe-hub-part-answered.html; fe-hub carries one blue tag reading "Not yet started" and ten status cells carrying govuk-task-list__status--cannot-start-yet, and fe-hub-part-answered carries one green tag reading "Completed". Checked the colour claim, which is the part most likely to be assumed rather than read: frontend NOT_STARTED maps to govuk-tag--blue and FULFILLED to govuk-tag--green (hub/controller.js:51-62), Design release 1's statusTodo is govuk-tag--blue and statusComplete govuk-tag--green (app/routes.js:5736-5737), and the rendered tags on both sides carry those classes — so the words are the only difference, as claimed. Checked the "In progress" and "Optional" caveat: neither string appears in either captured frontend hub DOM, which is what the prose already says. CORRECT.

relatedTo.why: "Cannot start yet" is only shown because rows are locked, so unlocking the rows retires that status word.
